442| \begin{exercise}[$\star\star\star$]\label{exo:b1:quantum-introduction:12}
443| \emph{零点能。}(a) 对谐振子 $E = p^2/2m +
444| \tfrac12m\omega^2x^2$，取 $\Delta x\,\Delta p = \hbar/2$，并对 $\Delta x$ 求 $E \approx
